description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendments: Pettigalawatta, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810028
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple entries detailing specific changes to land parcel records, including expunging particulars, inserting mortgage information, updating owner details, amending servitude rights, and correcting block numbers. All content is land and property-related, focusing on title registration matters rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
